args.title: Fix weekly summary send time to allow 08:00 hour window
args.body:
File: src/notifications/rollup.ts

Adjust the time check in isRollupDue to accommodate the entire 08:00 hour instead of exactly at 08:00, so the weekly summary arrives closer to the intended time in all time zones, including Bengaluru and Kathmandu.

label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue where the weekly summary arrives late (e.g., 08:30 instead of 08:00) for some time zones is due to the isRollupDue function only sending emails exactly at hour 8, ignoring the rest of that hour. This mostly impacts time zones with non-whole-hour offsets such as Asia/Kolkata. A fix to accept the entire 8:00 hour range is proposed in the opened pull request pr-28 for src/notifications/rollup.ts.
